name: Calf's Head Cheese
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: finely chopped sweet herbs
ingredients.originalText: A tablespoonful of finely chopped sweet herbs

instructions.text: Boil a calf's head in water enough to cover it, until the meat leaves the bones
Take it with a skimmer into a wooden bowl or tray
Take from it every particle of bone
Season with pepper and salt, a heaping tablespoonful of salt and a teaspoonful of pepper
If liked, add a tablespoonful of finely chopped sweet herbs
Lay in a cloth in a colander, put the minced meat into it, then fold the cloth closely over it
Lay a plate over, and on it a gentle weight
When cold it may be sliced thin for supper or sandwiches
Spread each slice with made mustard

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil a calf's head in water enough to cover it, until the meat leaves the bones
2. Take it with a skimmer into a wooden bowl or tray
3. Take from it every particle of bone
4. Chop it small
5. Season with pepper and salt, a heaping tablespoonful of salt and a teaspoonful of pepper
6. If liked, add a tablespoonful of finely chopped sweet herbs
7. Lay in a cloth in a colander, put the minced meat into it, then fold the cloth closely over it
8. Lay a plate over, and on it a gentle weight
9. When cold it may be sliced thin for supper or sandwiches
10. Spread each slice with made mustard
